title: Real glass blur on every device, cost reported not bounded; rose icon as an adaptive Android icon and on Apple's grid
context: Glass means live BackdropFilter blur; the phone Meadow stacks up to three blurred layers over an animated scene, the costliest case on the Note 10+ (Impeller on OpenGL ES). The owner also supplied /Users/satanshumishra/Downloads/field-notes-icon-rose.svg as the app icon, replacing the default Flutter icon.
options: step down where it drops frames
outcome: Real blur everywhere; frame cost on the Note 10+ is measured and reported in review, no stepped-down glass. Android gets an adaptive icon (#b8566a background, cream peony foreground inside the safe zone) plus regenerated legacy PNGs; macOS renders the rounded square at 824 of 1024 with margin and shadow; the icon ships as its own unit.
